explication: WhatCable is a macOS menu-bar application that observes USB-C ports, power, displays, USB devices, and Thunderbolt state, then explains cable capability and charging bottlenecks. The primary workflow is: macOS hardware events are collected by the Darwin backend, assembled into a cable snapshot, enriched and diagnosed by WhatCableCore, and rendered in the popover, CLI, notifications, and widgets. The tree and excerpts show orchestration and core data shaping clearly; several Pro and rendering links are inferred only from documented responsibilities.
